item.title: Dueling Times Square rallies on Iran distill differing visions for America
item.description: Leftists decry 'imperialist' war, before Iranians and allies celebrate strikes on regime in the same place, underlining opposing views toward the US role abroad The post Dueling Times Square rallies on Iran distill differing visions for America appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: New York Jewish Democratic leaders condemn campaign against Iran
item.description: Statements against US-Israeli airstrikes underline differences with mainstream Jewish organizations The post New York Jewish Democratic leaders condemn campaign against Iran appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Suspect in New York Chabad headquarters ramming hit with federal charges
item.description: Dan Sohail charged with intentionally damaging religious property, after hate crimes accusations in local US court; NYPD data shows 21 bias incidents targeting Jews last month The post Suspect in New York Chabad headquarters ramming hit with federal charges appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Rubio reveals US launched strikes against Iran because of planned Israeli attack
item.description: Top diplomat says US understood its assets would be hit by Iran in retaliation for a preemptive Israeli strike, even though Jerusalem seen as unlikely to have acted without Trump's blessing The post Rubio reveals US launched strikes against Iran because of planned Israeli attack appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US warns its citizens to urgently leave almost all Mideast countries, including Israel
item.description: Uptick in American attacks on Iran expected in coming day, US official tells CNN; Trump vows revenge on Iran for attack on US embassy in Riyadh, deaths of 6 troops in Kuwait The post US warns its citizens to urgently leave almost all Mideast countries, including Israel appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Renewed rocket fire from Lebanon targets northern Israel as IDF strikes in Iran, Beirut

item.title: In Jerusalem’s Katamon neighborhood, levelheadedness and levity prevail as rockets fly

item.title: WWII vet who shielded Jews at Nazi POW camp at gunpoint gets medal of honor
item.description: Highest US military distinction given posthumously to Roderick W. Edmonds, who refused to let Nazis separate Jewish prisoners of war in 1945 The post WWII vet who shielded Jews at Nazi POW camp at gunpoint gets medal of honor appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Iran soccer team’s 2026 World Cup place in US put in doubt by Middle East war
item.description: FIFA has Iraq next in line should the Islamic Republic withdraw, in which case it would be fined and forego at least $10.5 million from the global soccer federation, plus fines The post Iran soccer team’s 2026 World Cup place in US put in doubt by Middle East war appeared first on The Times of Israel.
